title: Complete cloud migration for Dynamics GP

facts.text: Validate migrated data by running validation tests from Cloud Migration Management page.
Disable cloud migration in Cloud Migration Setup once desired data migrated.
Each migration run overwrites outstanding documents and changes made in target company.
When cloud migration disabled, setup deleted but integration runtime remains.
Integration runtime cloud registration auto-cleaned after couple weeks of non-use.
Set up user accounts in Microsoft 365 tenant with Business Central licenses.
Create Business Central user accounts associated with Microsoft 365 email addresses.
Assign proper permission sets to users in Business Central.
